description: Survey open-ended response themes — Code open-ended survey or feedback responses into themes with Workers AI: each theme gets a name, description, sentiment, the response ids that belong to it, count and percent (computed offline), a representative quote verified to be verbatim, and a suggested action. Also returns overall sentiment, summary, unassigned and outlier responses, duplicate count and top recurring terms. text= holds responses one per line (URL-encode newlines as %0A) or |-separated with sep=pipe; optional question= for context and max_themes= (default 8, max 12). Up to 200 responses / 14k characters. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
